thread:
Lena B: UX flag: the bulk-approve flow for prompt sets currently shows a modal that immediately applies labels on confirm with no obvious undo. Users asked for an undo/confirmation pattern after a large batch.
Marco H: We intentionally applied immediately to avoid blocking long operations, but agree we need a safer affordance for large counts.
Anya R: Two options:
- Lightweight: apply immediately + show a persistent snackbar "Applied X labels. Undo" with 10s timeout.
- Protective: show a confirm modal with a typed acknowledgement for >500 items.
Jules P: Accessibility: snackbars are tricky for screen readers. If we use snackbar+undo, it must be announced (aria-live) and keyboard focus shouldn't get trapped.
a11y-bot: Recommendation: announce with polite aria-live and include an offscreen "Undo" button reachable by keyboard (tab order). Avoid forcing focus to snackbar.
Lena B: Also product: need to surface scope: are we approving this run only, the whole prompt set, or all runs? Current modal has a vague "apply to similar" checkbox.
Marco H: Proposal: keep modal simple but add a scope dropdown (Run / Suite / Prompt set) and show estimated affected count inline. If >200, show snackbar+undo by default; if >1000, require typed confirmation.
Anya R: Copy suggestions:
- Snackbar: "Approved 1,240 cases. Undo"
- Modal helper: "This will mark 1,240 cases as Pass in the prompt set. You can undo for 10s."
Jules P: Keyboard flow: after confirm, return focus to the table row the user came from. Ensure Undo is focusable via Tab next.
a11y-bot: Also include role="status" for the snackbar and expose total count in the announcement: "1,240 items approved. Undo available." 
Lena B: Action items:
- Marco: add scope dropdown + estimated count to mock + threshold rules (200/1000).
- Anya: finalize copy variants for snack + typed confirm.
- Jules: keyboard/focus spec + SR announcement text.
- a11y-bot: provide exact ARIA snippet for snackbar.
Lena B: I'll schedule a quick sync if anyone wants to debate numbers. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
